prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'component': 'Global API Gateway', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 1, 'component': 'SSO Broker', 'region': 'APAC', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 480}, {'i': 2, 'component': 'Central Rate Limiter', 'region': 'ANZ', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 3, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 4, 'component': 'Circuit Breaker', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 5, 'component': 'Central Rate Limiter', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 6, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 7, 'component': 'OAuth Authorization Server', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 8, 'component': 'Resource Quota Manager', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 9, 'component': 'SSO Broker', 'region': 'EU-Central', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 480}, {'i': 10, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 11, 'component': 'Vendor Integration Hub', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 12, 'component': 'Circuit Breaker', 'region': 'EU-Central', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 13, 'component': 'Central Rate Limiter', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 14, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}]

response: {"incidents": [{"i": 0, "summary": "Global API Gateway degradation in EU-West impacting API throughput for 5 hours (major)."}, {"i": 1, "summary": "Critical outage of the SSO Broker in APAC blocking all enterprise logins for 8 hours."}, {"i": 2, "summary": "Central Rate Limiter failure in ANZ causing temporary API request throttling issues (major)."}, {"i": 3, "summary": "Global Social Login Connector outage preventing third-party authentication for 30 minutes."}, {"i": 4, "summary": "Critical circuit breaker misconfiguration in LATAM tripping backend services for 3 hours."}, {"i": 5, "summary": "Global Central Rate Limiter incident resulting in widespread API request rejections."}, {"i": 6, "summary": "Repeated global failure of Social Login Connector services, blocking external auth flows."}, {"i": 7, "summary": "OAuth Authorization Server down globally for 30 minutes, critical impact on token issuance."}, {"i": 8, "summary": "Resource Quota Manager outage globally prevented new resource allocations for 30 minutes."}, {"i": 9, "summary": "SSO Broker instability in EU-Central caused prolonged authentication delays for 8 hours."}, {"i": 10, "summary": "Critical Social Login Connector failure in US-West disrupting external login options."}, {"i": 11, "summary": "Vendor Integration Hub in EU-West experienced a critical outage, halting partner data syncs."}, {"i": 12, "summary": "Circuit Breaker tripped incorrectly in EU-Central, causing cascading service failures for 2 hours."}, {"i": 13, "summary": "Central Rate Limiter issues in LATAM led to excessive API throttling for 2 hours."}, {"i": 14, "summary": "Job Scheduler failure in US-East delayed critical batch processing tasks for 30 minutes."}]}
